title: Three reasons why AI is not conscious and perhaps never will be
title_zh: 人工智能为何不具备意识，或许永远不会：三个原因
abstract: Large language models can mimic thought and feeling with uncanny skill. But evidence from neuroscience suggests that intelligence alone is not enough for subjective experience.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型可以以惊人的技巧模仿思维和情感。然而，神经科学证据表明，单纯的智力不足以产生主观体验。
snippet: Large language models can mimic thought and feeling with uncanny skill. But evidence from neuroscience suggests that intelligence alone is not enough for subjective experience.
authors_text: Anil K. Seth, Ned Block, Giulio Tononi
